name: pre-read-subagent-attribution
description: SB-25 R2 attribution: a subagent's commit is credited to the SUBAGENT id, not the parent session. Preflight: the parent reads (SHARED), then subagent A edits + commits v2 under the composite identity — invalidating the parent. The parent's re-read is stale and summary.last_writer_session_id MUST be the SUBAGENT's composite agent id -- uuid5 of 'ccs-agent:claude-session-<sid>:subagent-<sub>', which both backends derive byte-identically -- so the [:8] short form in prose names the actual writer and not the parent. R7 changed what this field carries: it was the bare subagent id, recovered by running that derivation backwards. The 32-char hex form is deliberate and load-bearing here: the harness scrubs any 8-4-4-4-12 value in a string position, so a hyphenated spelling would normalize to <UUID> and this assertion would pass for ANY writer -- and warn_mode/ may not declare preserve_identity. Timestamps + prose are ignored (vary per run); the attribution field is the parity contract.
